title: Constrained Code Generation with Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.16829v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) are a powerful, emerging paradigm for code generation. They construct programs through iterative refinement of partially corrupted token sequences and enable parallel token refinement. Importantly, this paradigm exposes a global program state at each denoising step, which provides a natural intervention point for enforcing program-level functionality and security constraints, guiding the generation before the final code is committed. Building on this observation, the paper introduces Constrained Diffusion for Code (CDC), an inference-time neurosymbolic framework that integrates constraint satisfaction directly into the reverse denoising process without retraining the base diffusion model. CDC augments the base diffusion sampler with constraint-aware denoising operators that combine mathematical optimization with program analysis to identify constraint-relevant regions of the intermediate program state

translated_title: 基于扩散语言模型的约束代码生成
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型（DLM）是一种强大的新兴代码生成范式。它通过对部分损坏的token序列进行迭代细化来构建程序，并支持并行token细化。重要的是，该范式在每个去噪步骤中都会暴露全局程序状态，这为实施程序级的功能与安全约束提供了一个自然的干预点，可以在最终代码确定之前对生成过程进行引导。基于这一观察，本文提出了面向代码的约束扩散，这是一个推理阶段的神经符号框架，它将约束满足直接集成到反向去噪过程中，而无需重新训练基础扩散模型。CDC通过约束感知的去噪算子增强了基础扩散采样器，这些算子将数学优化与程序分析相结合，以识别中间程序状态中与约束相关的区域。
tldr: 本文提出推理时神经符号框架CDC，无需重新训练扩散模型，通过将数学优化与程序分析相结合的约束感知去噪算子嵌入反向去噪过程，从而在代码生成中强制执行功能与安全约束。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CDC, an inference-time neurosymbolic framework that enforces functionality and security constraints in code generation by embedding constraint-aware denoising operators—combining mathematical optimization with program analysis—into the reverse denoising process of diffusion language models without retraining.
